title: Flat extension preserves finite intersections of ideals
statement:
Let $f:R\to S$ be a flat homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] of commutative rings. Let $A$ be a finite index set and $(I_a)_{a\in A}$ ideals of $R$. Write $I_aS$ for the ideal generated by $f(I_a)$. Then
$$\left(\bigcap_{a\in A}I_a\right)S=\bigcap_{a\in A}(I_aS).$$
For $A=\varnothing$ both sides mean $S$.
